text: APPROVE: The extracted `ResolveGoEmbedPattern` turns each `continue` into `return null` and the caller adds only non-null results, so behaviour is the same, and moving the nested conditionals out should bring `CollectGoEmbedRefs` well under 15. I could not confirm the build from the diff alone, since it assumes `HostEmbedRef` is a reference type and nullable annotations are enabled, which both look likely.
